weaknesses.title: Var named NOTE is poisoned by NOTE statement
weaknesses.detail: DEFAULT NOTE=... then NOTE "action open" overwrites the var with log text (dump showed note:action open). Agents must use BODY/MSG not NOTE for payload vars.
weaknesses.repro: DEFAULT NOTE="ERROR..."; NOTE "action open"; SETF note NOTE → action open

weaknesses.title: COUNTINF needle var NEEDLE hard-fails
weaknesses.detail: COUNTINF obj field NEEDLE → err 'COUNTINF object field needle'. Same reserved class as GREPF NEEDLE. Use WANT.
weaknesses.repro: DEFAULT NEEDLE="ERROR"; COUNTINF i note NEEDLE → hard err

weaknesses.title: REPLACEF args FROM/TO reserved
weaknesses.detail: REPLACEF note FROM TO → 'REPLACEF object field old new'. Rename OLDSTR/NEWSTR.
weaknesses.repro: REPLACEF i note FROM TO with FROM/TO vars

weaknesses.title: HASINF case-sensitive vs HASIFI dual path
weaknesses.detail: Easy false miss on ERROR vs error; agents must pick HASIFI for logs. Not a bug but ops footgun.

weaknesses.title: REQUIRE=abc softens
weaknesses.detail: Non-numeric REQUIRE miss exit 0 on gate deny.

workarounds: Never name payload vars NOTE — use BODY
Never name COUNTINF/GREPF needle NEEDLE — use WANT
Never name REPLACEF args FROM/TO — use OLDSTR/NEWSTR
HASIFI for case-fold log triage; HASINF exact
Fixed i0/i1/i2; TRY* soft; numeric REQUIRE only
